scope: Watch startup caption preference and pause when fully outside viewport
status: runtime-pass; external caption behavior requires live verification
tests: Visible explicit request plays on Ready
Fully out of view pauses; partly visible stays playing
Return to viewport and foreground never auto-resume
Out of view before Ready prevents startup playback
Stale observers/API callbacks cannot mutate current player; stop disconnects observer
Initial exposed track option requested once; later viewer CC choice retained
Unavailable/throwing caption options do not prevent playback
Existing four-card one-player, errors, timeouts, Close/Escape/focus tests pass
captionLimitation: Official cc_load_policy documentation defines1 to force captions on; default follows viewer preference, so0 alone does not guarantee off. Official module table lists fontSize and reload, not track. Code requests track={} only if runtime explicitly exposes track; this guarded behavior is best effort and cannot be advertised as universally guaranteed caption-off. JSDOM verifies calls and lifecycle, not YouTube live rendering.
browserLimitation: Root owns actual YouTube/browser acceptance; this review used primary docs and deterministic runtime fixtures.
